assign.outcome:
The phone sheet is now one class, `Sheet` ([ext/drawer/Sheet.js](/framework/ext/drawer/)), merged as 41c9607e7 and checked on the live site (✦ opens, ✕ closes, the desktop ☰ opens the AI tab). The audit found that one ☰ icon means navigation on a phone and AI on a desktop, that `hides-nav` does nothing, and that a per-page `<path>/ai/` already exists in Servex but not as a page. The proposal has 5 mocked control layouts and 9 steps, each waiting for the owner's yes.

[audit.md](audit.md) · [proposal.md](proposal.md) · [variants](variants/index.html)

Left: steps 2 to 9 wait for a yes. The decision needed first is whether `<path>/ai/` becomes a routed page, with a real `ai` child winning (the alternative is `<path>/~ai/`). There are no test files for ext/drawer or ux/Dictate, so the proof was a smoke run plus a headless probe.
